findings.message: The page header, filter panel, results heading, and result cards use nearly identical surface and border treatments, so primary task, supporting controls, and content have weak visual hierarchy.
findings.remediation: Establish a deliberate page composition with a distinct masthead, compact task-focused filter region, and a single structured results surface rather than isolated generic cards.

findings.message: Most relationships reuse 16px or 24px spacing without distinguishing tightly related content, component internals, section boundaries, and page-level rhythm.
findings.remediation: Define named composition spacing roles and verify rendered relationships at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

findings.message: The clear action is visually detached from the fields and aligns with the control edge rather than the filter task, producing an accidental floating-button appearance.
findings.remediation: Give the toolbar explicit anatomy for search, secondary filters, result count, and reset action with breakpoint-specific alignment.

findings.message: Result cards are authored directly in the story, leaving identity, metadata, status, action alignment, truncation, and responsive behavior outside the pattern contract.
findings.remediation: Move result-row anatomy into the experimental pattern so consumers and AI agents cannot invent these relationships independently.

findings.message: The danger action color is approximately 4.26:1 on the default surface and the strong control border is approximately 2.79:1 on a raised surface, below WCAG AA expectations for normal text and required UI boundaries.
findings.remediation: Adopt explicit semantic contrast pairs, darken the danger text role and control-boundary role, and enforce their ratios with deterministic token tests.

findings.message: Current checks validate code, contracts, packaging, and accessibility semantics but have no approved screenshot baseline, rendered geometry assertions, or token contrast audit.
findings.remediation: Add a design-check command covering WCAG AA token pairs, AAA reporting, responsive geometry, overflow, target sizes, and approved visual snapshots.
